name: vesma-cortex-gate-contract
revised: 2026-10-05 (v3: sanity_v2 exam + zoned monotonicity; owner ratification 2026-10-05, PR #10 addenda; thresholds ride in a separate car from artifacts)
authority: docs/specs/eval-methodology.md #6 (anti-HARKing: values are pinned there and in CI)
separation_rule: A PR that changes this file must not contain artifact changes, and vice versa (eval-methodology #6) — hence this file lives OUTSIDE models/vesma-cortex-v1/.

invariants.feature_contract: manifest feature order == ONNX metadata 'features' == cortex.features.pair.FEATURE_NAMES (frozen 13); feature_set_sha256 == digest of that order
invariants.typed_output: 100% typed verdicts: every response carries a valid Noul + Score

monotonicity.rule: P non-increasing as cosine drops over the fixed probe pair OUTSIDE the razor zone (0.95; 1.0); the zone itself is TWO-VALUED by policy v1.1 (both classes live there), so no monotonicity is asserted inside it — operationally P(0.95) >= P(0.8) >= P(0.5), steps 1.0 -> 0.99 -> 0.95 unchecked (eval-methodology #10.2, sanity_v2.monotonicity_v2)

cosmetic_twin.metric: P(dup | cosmetic twin of the probe: title punctuation — policy v1.1 #8.2 re-classed the v1 'title + !' perturbation from T3 to cosmetic/T1)
cosmetic_twin.note: sanity v2 probe (i); supersedes the v1 near_boundary corridor (same numbers, policy-correct class); cut = the runner DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD_PROBABILITY; catches threshold-edge collapses, does not rank close revisions

verdicts.layer_b: ADOPT/DECLINE by the frozen prereg v2 decision rule (6 conditions); owner decision
verdicts.b0_delta_rate: field-value criterion, not an artifact-quality gate

probes.source: src/cortex/eval/sanity.py — PROBE_RECORD / UNRELATED_RECORD (frozen synthetic content; no store, no network; deterministic)
probes.runner: scripts/eval_sanity_suite.py --bundle <dir-or-model.onnx> — exit code != 0 means FAIL, no ADOPT on a red suite
probes.pairs_computed_via: cortex.features.pair.features only (#480 lesson: local feature-math copies drift from the production wrapper)
probe_classes_covered: cosmetic twin (policy v1.1 T1: title punctuation / case / whitespace)
fact-edit twin (policy v1.1 T3 razor: key-fact token in the body)
envelope-variant (policy v1.1 whitelist #8.1: feature-degenerate by OQ-2, degeneracy pinned by test)
monotonicity (zoned v2: razor zone two-valued, non-increase outside it)
probe_classes_tails: translated twins (in ds1000 synth, not in the suite)
probes.note: coverage table per eval-methodology #7; tails are known blind spots, kept visible, not silent

sanity_v2.blocks: pre-ADOPT sanity exam v2 (eval-methodology #10; two-sided razor-zone exam per policy v1.1 #8)
authority: docs/specs/labeling-policy-b2.md #8 (policy v1.1: envelope whitelist, punctuation = cosmetic)
sanity_v2.consumer: cortex.eval.sanity (frozen code constants; coherence with this section pinned by tests/test_eval_sanity.py)

probe_facts.cosmetic_twin: probe vs title+'!' twin at cos 0.99 — required dup, P >= 0.5
probe_facts.fact_edit_twin: probe vs a key-fact token edited in the BODY (cache-key name cart->card, policy v1.1 #8.2 'names' class) at cos 0.99 — required NOT dup, P < 0.5
probe_facts.envelope_variant: probe vs the same record differing ONLY in an envelope attribute (observation date, whitelist #8.1) at cos 1.0 — required dup, P >= 0.5; envelope fields are OUTSIDE the frozen 13-feature surface (OQ-2: CanonRecordView carries no timestamp), so the probe is feature-degenerate to the self-pair by contract — the check pins the policy verdict and becomes load-bearing the moment the feature surface grows envelope fields (degeneracy pinned by test)

monotonicity_v2.razor_zone: (0.95; 1.0) — open, TWO-VALUED by policy v1.1 (T1 cosmetic positives and T3 fact-edit negatives both live there); monotonicity is NOT asserted inside the zone
monotonicity_v2.rule: outside the razor zone non-strict non-increase holds (tol 1e-06); operationally on the ladder: P(0.95) >= P(0.8) >= P(0.5); steps 1.0 -> 0.99 -> 0.95 are not checked

corner_qa.blocks: pre-train corpus acceptance (dataset-v4 plan wave 2): a corpus failing ANY of these is not exported, not fingerprinted, not sealed — holdout metrics are blind to corpus defects (#480 lesson)
authority: docs/experiments/b2p-v41-sanity-fail-diagnosis.md (C1 corpus correction, wave D4-4, 2026-10-05: presence counters, no existing threshold revised)
corner_qa.consumer: cortex.data.corner_qa.CornerQAThresholds (loader falls back to the frozen code constants when this section is absent — backward compatibility)

g1_feature_ceiling.rule: for every monotone-duplicative feature: max f(negatives) <= max f(positives)

corner_qa.cos_strata_calibration: vesma-embed-v1 measures ~0.51 on fully unrelated topics, so the [0.40; 0.55) band is reachable only marginally; the load-bearing line is min_pairs_below_cos_084 (B2 floor 0.836) — TL arbitration 2026-10-05 (1): embedder physics accepted, corpus floor 0.450
corner_qa.change_control: same as global: pre-registered addendum BEFORE the run; a threshold change re-runs corner-QA on the sealed corpus and, if a gate flips, forces a corpus rebuild by the same procedure with a disclosed event

change_control: Thresholds change only by a pre-registered addendum BEFORE the eval run; raising a merge-gate threshold requires an owner directive (ADR 0003, 'Позиции и споры'; engine ADR-0026 precedent). Layer B re-export exception: unchanged weights_sha256 -> 1e-6 output equivalence on the frozen set instead of burning the holdout (eval-methodology #6).
